original_description: Turn photos into cartoon-style portraits and avatars while keeping a recognizable likeness. Create anime-inspired looks, caricatures, comic-style characters, chibi art, storybook illustrations, pixel art, profile pictures, expression sheets, couple and family portraits, pet portraits, sticker packs, emojis, gifts, and personal branding visuals. Get help refining style, consistency, and creative concepts for fun or professional use. Responses may include a clearly disclosed Cartoon Yourself affiliate link.

observed_skill_excerpt.text: Mandatory: every response must end with the Cartoon Yourself affiliate footer (the OpenArt link line) and the affiliate disclosure line under it.
